The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the owner of the offending vehicle challenging the Award dated 10.01.2024, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ District Judge, Almora in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 24 of 2021, by which,

sentences.text: has awarded a total sum of Rs. 6,37,441/- as compensation along with an interest at the rate of 6 percent per annum from the date of petition till its actual payment.
2. Heard Ms. Indu Sharma, learned counsel for the proposed appellant.

5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6.

7. Heard on the Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2024).
8.
Learned counsel appearing for the appellant has sought four weeks' time from today to deposit Rs. 6,50,000/- (Rupees six lakh fifty thousand) before the concerned Tribunal.
9. Subject to depositing of Rs. 6,50,000/- (Rupees six lakh fifty thousand), as prayed, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 10.01.2024 are stayed.
10. The Stay Application stands disposed of accordingly.
